close_reason: Renumbered duplicate step 4 label: MAIL FROM→5, RCPT TO→6, DATA→7, body→8, acceptance→9, QUIT→10
description: run_smtp_session in relay_client.rs labels its steps 1-9, but both the AUTH block and the MAIL FROM block are labeled '// 4. AUTH PLAIN' and '// 4. MAIL FROM'. The session has 9 distinct steps; MAIL FROM should be step 5 and DATA step 6. A contributor adding a new step would follow the wrong numbering pattern. Fix: renumber steps 4 (MAIL FROM) → 5, 5 (RCPT TO) → 6, 6 (DATA) → 7, 7 (body) → 8, 8 (DATA response) → 9, 9 (QUIT) → 10.
title: Duplicate '// 4.' step label in run_smtp_session (AUTH and MAIL FROM both labeled step 4)
